translations.idiomatic: Cui Yin resented Yi for having replaced him, framed him as a partisan of Li Maozhen, and had him banished.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以朱朴兼判戶部，凡軍旅財賦之事，上一以委之。

translations.literal: On jihai, Zhu Pu was additionally assigned to oversee the Ministry of Revenue; all matters of military finance and taxation the emperor wholly entrusted to him.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Zhu Pu was additionally put in charge of the Ministry of Revenue, and the emperor entrusted him with all military finance and taxation.

sentences.zh: 以孫偓為鳳翔四面行營都統，又以前定難節度使李思諫為靜難節度使，兼副都統。

translations.literal: Sun Wo was made Overall Commander of the Fengxiang Campaign on all sides, and former Military Governor of Dingnan Li Sijian was made Military Governor of Jingnan and concurrently Deputy Overall Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Wo was made overall commander of the Fengxiang campaign on all sides, and former Dingnan Military Governor Li Sijian was appointed Jingnan Military Governor and deputy overall commander.

sentences.zh: 以保大留後李思敬為節度使。

translations.literal: Li Sijing, acting commissioner of Baoda, was made military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sijing, acting commissioner of Baoda, was appointed military governor.

sentences.zh: 河東將李存信攻臨清，敗汴將葛從周於宗城北，乘勝至魏州北門。

translations.literal: The Hedong general Li Cunxin attacked Linqing, defeated the Bian general Ge Congzhou north of Zongcheng, and pressing his victory reached the north gate of Wei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Hedong general Li Cunxin attacked Linqing, routed Ge Congzhou north of Zongcheng, and pressed his victory to the north gate of Wei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，壬子，加孫偓行營節度、招討、處置等使。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on renzi, Sun Wo was additionally made campaign military governor, pacification commissioner, and disposition commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renzi, Sun Wo was additionally made campaign military governor, pacification commissioner, and disposition commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁已，以韓健權知京兆尹，兼把截使。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Han Jian was appointed Acting Prefect of Jingzhao and concurrently Interdiction Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Han Jian was made acting prefect of Jingzhao and interdiction commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊午，李茂貞上表請罪，願得自新，仍獻助修宮室錢；

translations.literal: On wuwu, Li Maozhen submitted a memorial asking forgiveness, expressing willingness to reform, and also offered money to help repair the palace halls;
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Li Maozhen memorialized asking pardon, promising to reform, and offered money toward rebuilding the palace;

sentences.zh: 韓建復佐佑之，竟不出師。

translations.literal: Han Jian again supported him, and in the end no troops were sent out.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian backed him again, and in the end no punitive expedition was launched.

sentences.zh: 錢鏐令兩浙吏民上表，請以鏐兼領浙東；

translations.literal: Qian Liu had officials and people of the two Zhe circuits submit memorials asking that Liu be additionally put in charge of eastern Zhe;
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liu had officials and commoners across the two Zhe circuits petition that he be given eastern Zhe as well;

sentences.zh: 朝廷不得已，復以王摶為吏部尚書、同平章事，以鏐為鎮海、威勝兩軍度使。

translations.literal: The court had no choice; Wang Tuan was again made Director of the Ministry of Personnel and Co-Grand Councilor, and Liu was made military governor of the Zhenhai and Weisheng armies.
translations.idiomatic: The court yielded: Wang Tuan was recalled as Director of Personnel and Co-Grand Councilor, and Liu was made military governor of both Zhenhai and Weisheng.

sentences.zh: 丙子，更名威勝曰鎮東軍。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Weisheng was renamed the Zhendong Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Weisheng was renamed the Zhendong Army.

sentences.zh: 李克用自將攻魏州，敗魏兵於白龍潭，追至觀音門。

translations.literal: Li Keyong personally led an attack on Wei Prefecture, defeated Wei troops at White Dragon Pool, and pursued them to Guanyin Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong personally led an attack on Wei Prefecture, routed Wei troops at White Dragon Pool, and pursued them to Guanyin Gate.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠復遣葛從周救之，屯於洹水，全忠以大軍繼之。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong again sent Ge Congzhou to the rescue; he encamped on the Huan River, and Quanzhong followed with the main army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong again sent Ge Congzhou to relieve the city; Congzhou encamped on the Huan River while Quanzhong followed with the main army.

sentences.zh: 克用乃還。

translations.literal: Keyong then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Keyong then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 加河中節度使王珂同平章事。

translations.literal: Wang Ke, Military Governor of Hezhong, was additionally appointed Co-Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ke, Military Governor of Hezhong, was additionally made Co-Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 十一月，朱全忠還大梁，復遣葛從周東會龐師古，攻鄆州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Zhu Quanzhong returned to Daliang and again sent Ge Congzhou east to join Pang Shigu in attacking Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Zhu Quanzhong returned to Daliang and again sent Ge Congzhou east to join Pang Shigu in the siege of Yun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 湖州刺史李師悅求旌節，詔置忠國軍於湖州，以師悅為節度使。

translations.literal: Li Shiyue, Prefect of Hu Prefecture, requested a military commission; an edict established the Zhongguo Army at Hu Prefecture and made Shiyue its military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiyue, prefect of Hu Prefecture, petitioned for a formal military commission; the court created the Zhongguo Army at Hu and made him its military governor.

sentences.zh: 賜告身旌節者未入境，戊子，師悅卒。

translations.literal: The bearer of the commission credentials and insignia had not yet entered the prefecture when, on wuzi, Shiyue died.
translations.idiomatic: Before the bearer of his commission and insignia had even crossed the border, Shiyue died on wuzi.

sentences.zh: 楊行密表師悅子前綿州刺史彥徽知州事。

translations.literal: Yang Xingmi memorialized that Shiyue's son Yan Hui, former Prefect of Mian Prefecture, should administer the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi memorialized that Shiyue's son Yan Hui, former prefect of Mian, be put in charge of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 淮南將安仁義攻婺州。

translations.literal: The Huainan general An Renyi attacked Wu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Huainan general An Renyi attacked Wu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月，東川兵焚掠漢、眉、資簡之境。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Eastern Chuan troops burned and plundered the territories of Han, Mei, Zi, and Jian.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Eastern Chuan troops burned and plundered Han, Mei, Zi, and Jian.

sentences.zh: 清海節度使薛王知柔行至湖南，廣州牙將盧琚、譚弘𤣱據境拒之，使弘𤣱守端州。

translations.literal: Xue Wang Zhirou, Military Governor of Qinghai, reached Hunan on his way to his post; the Guangzhou guard generals Lu Ju and Tan Hongji held the territory and barred his passage, leaving Hongji to defend Duan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Xue Zhirou, newly appointed Military Governor of Qinghai, reached Hunan on his way south; Guangzhou guard officers Lu Ju and Tan Hongji blocked his entry and left Hongji to hold Duan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 弘𤣱結封州刺史劉隱，許妻以女。

translations.literal: Hongji allied with Liu Yin, prefect of Fengzhou, and promised to give him his daughter in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Hongji allied with Liu Yin, prefect of Fengzhou, and promised his daughter in marriage.

sentences.zh: 隱偽許之，託言親迎，伏甲舟中，夜入端州，斬弘𤣱；

translations.literal: Yin falsely agreed, claiming he was coming to welcome the bride, hid armored soldiers in boats, entered Duanzhou by night, and beheaded Hongji;
translations.idiomatic: Yin pretended to agree, claiming he was coming to welcome the bride, hid armored soldiers in boats, entered Duanzhou by night, and beheaded Hongji;

sentences.zh: 遂襲廣州，斬琚；

translations.literal: he then attacked Guangzhou and beheaded Ju;
translations.idiomatic: he then attacked Guangzhou and beheaded Ju;

sentences.zh: 具軍容迎知柔入視事，知柔表隱為行軍司馬。

translations.literal: with full military honors he welcomed Zhirou to take office, and Zhirou memorialized Yin as acting army marshal.
translations.idiomatic: with full military honors he welcomed Zhirou to take office, and Zhirou memorialized Yin as acting army marshal.
